text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин reigns supreme in the
BNW battle.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As she basks in her victory, she comes to

appreciate how joyful it is to have equals
she can
compete against.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Having reached the top, Нарита Таисин
once
again realizes the importance of
rivalry and
friendship.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She declares her next goal to be the
Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The year-end Grand Prix is where the
most
formidable racers test their mettle,
and Narita
Taishin wants to see where
she truly stands.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
